gloss: to extinguish (a fire); to put out a fire

definitions.gloss: to extinguish a fire; to put out a fire; to fight a fire
definitions.explanation: To stop a fire from burning by applying water, chemicals, or other means.

examples.japanese: {消防士|しょうぼうし}が{火|ひ}を{消火|しょうか}した。
{初期|しょき}{消火|しょうか}が{大切|たいせつ}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that early firefighting is important.

examples.japanese: {火災|かさい}は{通報|つうほう}から{約|やく}30{分|ぷん}で{消火|しょうか}された。
examples.english: The fire was extinguished about 30 minutes after the call was made.

notes:
{消火|しょうか}する combines {消|しょう} (extinguish) and {火|か} (fire). It is the standard technical term for firefighting and fire extinguishment. The noun {消火|しょうか} appears in many compound terms related to fire safety.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消火|しょうか}{器|き}: fire extinguisher
- {消火|しょうか}{栓|せん}: fire hydrant
- {消火|しょうか}{活動|かつどう}: firefighting operations
- {初期|しょき}{消火|しょうか}: initial firefighting (putting out a fire before it spreads)
- {消火|しょうか}{訓練|くんれん}: firefighting drill

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {火|ひ}を{消|け}す: to put out a fire — everyday expression using native Japanese words
- {鎮火|ちんか}する: to be extinguished; to die down — describes the fire being brought under control, often used in news reports for the result
- {防火|ぼうか}する: to prevent fire — focuses on prevention rather than extinguishing
